questions.subject: Programming skills · Sequencing
questions.text: A parcel kiosk must print a label before attaching it. Which pair preserves that dependency?
questions.explanation: The label must exist before it can be attached.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Sequencing
questions.text: A program sets lamp = off, then lamp = on. What is the final state?
questions.explanation: The later assignment replaces the earlier lamp value.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Sequencing
questions.text: An app saves a receipt before calculating its total. Which change fixes the order?
answers: Calculate the total before saving the receipt
questions.explanation: The saved receipt should use the completed calculation.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Sequencing
questions.text: Why write a numbered plan for a parcel-sorting program?
answers: To specify the order of its actions
To guarantee that no tests are needed
questions.explanation: A numbered plan makes action dependencies explicit.
